prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, home notification, sign_in hint, and sign_in layout because each has only 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path reorder changes across 2 tests.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 1 test (+4.2%), while 2 other tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy changes hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Sound & Action Primer Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive primer screen after home_intro where users test pet sound alerts and movement triggers before finishing setup. (why: Support receives multiple reports of post-onboarding confusion regarding how to interact with or control the desktop pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Step Reordering: Moves sign_in after pet adoption screens (pick_friend, upload_photos, adoption_certificate) so users establish emotional attachment before signing in. (why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% and takes 89s median. Securing pet choices first increases motivation to complete account creation.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Activity Teaser Stream During Wait: Shows animated activity teasers of the pet moving around on the waiting screen while background setup finishes. (why: The waiting stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s. Providing active visual teasers reduces perceived wait time and abandonments.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Single-Account Sync Safeguard Hint: Adds an inline sign-in hint emphasizing that pets are bound to the specific login method to prevent accidental multi-account creation. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again using a different login method.)
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Notification Switch: Adds a completion readiness toggle on home_intro to alert users the second their pet appears on the desktop background. (why: Three support emails reported pets not showing or users missing when the app finishes launching to desktop.)
5: [adoption, copy] Direct Photo Customization Value Headline Copy: Updates upload_photos headline to clearly explain how uploaded photos turn into an animated desktop pet. (why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet looks due to photo choice confusion.)
